findings.title: 6 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 46 top-holder wallets resolve to 6 linked groups holding 38.2% of supply. The largest (2 wallets) holds 19.1%.

findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 43.8% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 36.5% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 0.17% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $209,610,304 this week, far outpacing proven traders.

findings.title: Smart Money is holding
findings.detail: 29 Smart Money wallets hold 0.04% of supply.
